title: AIDO-EEA Python Reference Implementation
description: Validation-locked reference implementation for the Evidence Entitlement Audit (EEA) 1.0 human-governed, LLM-independent claim-level entitlement kernel. Includes deterministic validation scoring, locked T3/T6-R1/T8-R1 evidence summaries, regression tests, schemas, and release-hygiene metadata without autonomous semantic adjudication.
notes: Apache License 2.0 was authorized for the public reference implementation on 2026-09-01. The existing archived v0.2.0 Zenodo record was verified from the authenticated Zenodo GitHub integration page at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21936236. This main-branch metadata does not move or rewrite the frozen v0.2.0 tag. Future successor releases should receive their own archival identifiers rather than reusing the v0.2.0 DOI.
